what: Plan logs malformed checks captures but leaves status globals empty, so callers can treat an unreadable or producer-crash capture as non-failing
scenario_or_breakage: If run-relevant-checks-captured.sh exits before emitting STATUS/OK/SKIPPED, the post-round gate skips the failure branch and the loop continues; after lint applied, lines 210-216 can also break out because empty status is "not fail"
suggested_fix: Set STEP5_CHK_STATUS=fail and STEP5_CHK_FAILURE_REASON=capture-malformed when all checks discriminators are absent, or return a wrapper rc handled outside set -e; add a regression that malformed checks stalls rather than advancing

what: Plan's required-field check ignores RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED, which is a valid clean discriminator already consumed by the loop
scenario_or_breakage: Repos without scripts/relevant-checks.sh produce RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED=true from scripts/run-relevant-checks-captured.sh:140-143, but the proposed post-loop check would emit "required field missing" during normal operation
suggested_fix: Include STEP5_CHK_RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED in the discriminator check and diagnostic text, and add a skipped-capture fixture

what: New parsers section is planned without a Makefile target or shard wiring
scenario_or_breakage: Makefile comments state CI uses section targets, not the full test-review-and-fix target, so the new parser regression would not run under make lint/test-harnesses
suggested_fix: Add test-review-and-fix-parsers to .PHONY, define it as `bash ... --section parsers`, place it on a test-harnesses-N shard, and update the section-list docs if changed
